name: Anain Robles
office: City of Palmdale, Member of the City Council, 3rd District

items.text: Anain Robles is a small business owner running for Palmdale City Council District 3. In a 2026 questionnaire, he proposed balanced housing, prudent budgeting, clearer public communication, and partnerships to keep young residents in the Antelope Valley. He advocates for making budgets, contracts, major expenditures, and upcoming decisions available in clear language and easily accessible online. His platform emphasizes local business and family stability.
